arguments.sql:
WITH qualifying_users AS (
    SELECT u.XCL_052
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM badges b
          WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
            AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM badges b
          WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
            AND b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM posts p
          WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
            AND p.XCL_030 >= 1000
      )
),
user_posts AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT XCL_052 FROM qualifying_users)
),
posts_with_negative_comment AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_026
    FROM posts p
    JOIN comments c ON c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
    WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT XCL_052 FROM qualifying_users)
      AND c.XCL_007 < 60
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts_with_negative_comment) * 100.0 / 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_posts) AS percentage

WITH qualifying_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b1 ON u.XCL_052 = b1.XCL_002 AND b1.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
    INNER JOIN badges b2 ON u.XCL_052 = b2.XCL_002 AND b2.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
    INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'New York'
      AND p.XCL_031 >= 1000
),
user_posts AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN qualifying_users qu ON p.XCL_033 = qu.XCL_052
),
posts_with_negative AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT up.XCL_026
    FROM user_posts up
    INNER JOIN comments c ON up.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
    WHERE c.XCL_007 < 60
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT pwn.XCL_026) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT up.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM user_posts up
LEFT JOIN posts_with_negative pwn ON up.XCL_026 = pwn.XCL_026
